prefill.description: Pass 'entityName' (table logical name) to open the map for that table immediately. All fields are optional; with no prefill the tool opens on the table picker.

entityName.description: Table logical name, e.g. account or contoso_project

includeSystemSteps.description: Include hidden Microsoft/system plugin steps (default false)

events.description: Optional event filter; omit for all events. Well-known names are matched case-insensitively: Create, Update, Delete, Assign, SetState, Merge, Share, Unshare, Associate, Disassociate, Retrieve, RetrieveMultiple, AddToQueue, Qualify, Win, Lose, FormLoad, FormSave, FieldChange, Any. Custom API / action and other SDK messages use "Custom:<message>" or "Message:<message>" (message name case-sensitive). Unknown values are rejected with an error.

includeDiagrams.description: Append Mermaid pipeline diagrams to the Markdown report (headless execution mode, default false)

maxSyncItems.description: Flag an event/stage as stacked once it holds more than this many synchronous items (the 'too-many-sync' smell). Positive integer; default 5, matching the tool's smells.maxSyncItems setting.

returnTopic.description: Returns the structured logic map (schemaVersion 1) plus a Markdown report for the requested table.

logicMap.description: LogicMap JSON: table facts, items, pipeline[event][stage], columns, forms, externalTouchers, apps, dependencies, smells, sourceErrors

markdown.description: Human-readable Markdown report of the same map

error.description: Present only when the run could not complete normally: an invalid input, or a windowed run that failed, was cancelled or hit the caller's timeout (logicMap then holds the partial map). Absent on success, so read it when present but do not require it.
